variants: G1 (basic) and G1 EDU; the product page lists secondary development as available on the EDU version only.
availability_note: Unitree's shop sells the G1 and says it is backordered and will ship as soon as it is back in stock. The shop says that version does not support secondary development; the EDU version is bought by contacting Unitree's sales team.

named_models.name: UnifoLM-VLA-0
named_models.role_note: Unitree describes UnifoLM-VLA-0 as a vision-language-action large model in the UnifoLM series, designed for general-purpose humanoid robot manipulation; the twelve datasets its repository lists for its experiments were all recorded on the Unitree G1.

hardware.compute: An 8-core high-performance CPU. For the EDU version the product page lists a high computing power module, such as Orin, as an accessory.
hardware.sensors: A depth camera and 3D LiDAR, a four-microphone array, and dual joint encoders. The EDU version's optional Dex3-1 hand can carry tactile sensor arrays.
hardware.actuation: Low-inertia, high-speed internal-rotor permanent magnet synchronous motors on industrial-grade crossed roller bearings: 23 degrees of freedom on the basic G1 and 23 to 43 on the EDU version, which offers the force-controlled three-fingered Dex3-1 hand as an option.
hardware.power: A quick-release 13-string lithium smart battery (9000mAh) with about 2 hours of battery life, and a 54V 5A charger.

developer_access: The product page lists secondary development for the G1 EDU only. Unitree's unitree_rl_gym repository documents training a policy in simulation and deploying it to a physical G1 for motion control, and its unitree_ros2 repository documents controlling the robot directly with ROS 2 messages, without wrapping the SDK interface.
terms_note: Unitree's SDK, unitree_sdk2, is released under the BSD 3-Clause License. Unitree's terms page has Terms, After-sales Terms, Privacy Policy, Disclaimer, and End User License Agreement tabs; the after-sales tab is the hardware warranty policy, and the licence agreement is offered as a downloadable document rather than as page text. The product page lists an 8-month warranty for the G1 and 18 months for the EDU version.
not_verified: UnifoLM-VLA-0 and the documented policy interfaces are Unitree's own claims; the Atlas has not verified them. Every source is a Unitree web page or repository file that Unitree can change at any time.
